assumptions_metadata.task_description: Generate weekly editorial pages for a streaming service that highlight top-rated films by genre, rendering posters, synopsis, runtime, and cast details.

assumptions.assumption: 0.0 <= IMDB_Rating <= 10.0.
IMDB_Rating is recorded to at most one decimal place.
At least 90% of titles have IMDB_Rating >= 7.0.
Runtime ends with ' min'.
The substring before ' min' is all digits and parseable as an integer.
Parsed runtime_minutes is between 45 and 240.
At least 80% of titles have runtime_minutes in the range 80–180.
Genre is a comma-separated list of 1 to 3 tokens.

Each token in Genre must be one of {Action, Adventure, Animation, Biography, Comedy, Crime, Drama, Family, Fantasy, Film-Noir, History, Horror, Music, Musical, Mystery, Romance, Sci-Fi, Sport, Thriller, War, Western, Documentary}.
No duplicate genre token appears within a row.
At least 60% of rows include one of Drama, Comedy, or Action.
Certificate is non-null in at least 85% of rows.
When present, Certificate is one of {U, UA, A, G, PG, PG-13, R, NC-17, Not Rated, 12, 12A, 15, 18}.
Certificate values have no leading or trailing whitespace.
Poster_Link begins with 'http://' or 'https://'.
Poster_Link ends with '.jpg' or '.jpeg'.
At least 95% of Poster_Link values are unique across rows.
Overview is non-empty.
Overview length is between 50 and 500 characters.
Overview does not contain the characters '<' or '>'.
No_of_Votes is a positive integer.
At least 95% of titles have No_of_Votes >= 10,000.
When not null, Gross is parseable as a positive integer after removing commas.
Gross is non-null in at least 80% of rows.
Among non-null Gross values, at least 50% exceed 1,000,000.
The pair (Series_Title, Released_Year) is unique across the table.
Director is different from each of Star1, Star2, Star3, and Star4 within a row.
Within a row, Star1, Star2, Star3, and Star4 are all distinct.
Among rows with Meta_score present, Pearson correlation(IMDB_Rating, Meta_score) > 0.4.
For at least 80% of rows with Meta_score present, abs(Meta_score - IMDB_Rating*10) <= 30.
For rows with Released_Year >= 1980, Gross is non-null in at least 80% of such rows.

import argparse import os from pathlib import Path import pandas as pd import numpy as np import re def slugify(text: str) -> str: return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", str(text).lower()).strip("-") def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser() parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True) parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True) args = parser.parse_args() input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv') out_dir = Path(args.output) out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) df = pd.read_csv(input_csv) # Coerce core types used downstream df['IMDB_Rating'] = pd.to_numeric(df['IMDB_Rating'], errors='coerce') df['Released_Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Released_Year'], errors='coerce') df['No_of_Votes'] = pd.to_numeric(df['No_of_Votes'], errors='coerce') df['Meta_score'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Meta_score'], errors='coerce') # Guard uniqueness for keys before generating slugs # ASSERTION_START assert df[['Series_Title', 'Released_Year']].isna().sum().sum() == 0 assert df.duplicated(subset=['Series_Title', 'Released_Year']).sum() == 0 # ASSERTION_END # Validate and parse runtime runtime_str = df['Runtime'].astype(str) # ASSERTION_START ends_ok = runtime_str.str.endswith(' min') assert ends_ok.all() # ASSERTION_END minutes_str = runtime_str.str[:-4].str.strip() # ASSERTION_START digits_ok = minutes_str.str.match(r'^\d+$') assert digits_ok.all() # ASSERTION_END runtime_minutes = minutes_str.astype(int) # ASSERTION_START assert ((runtime_minutes >= 45) & (runtime_minutes <= 240)).all() # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START range_mask = (runtime_minutes >= 80) & (runtime_minutes <= 180) assert range_mask.mean() >= 0.80 # ASSERTION_END df['runtime_minutes'] = runtime_minutes # Validate genre tokens before grouping by genre genre_lists = df['Genre'].astype(str).apply(lambda s: [t.strip() for t in s.split(',') if t is not None]) allowed_genres = { 'Action', 'Adventure', 'Animation', 'Biography', 'Comedy', 'Crime', 'Drama', 'Family', 'Fantasy', 'Film-Noir', 'History', 'Horror', 'Music', 'Musical', 'Mystery', 'Romance', 'Sci-Fi', 'Sport', 'Thriller', 'War', 'Western', 'Documentary' } # ASSERTION_START lengths_ok = genre_lists.apply(lambda lst: 1 <= len(lst) <= 3) tokens_allowed = genre_lists.apply(lambda lst: all(tok in { 'Action', 'Adventure', 'Animation', 'Biography', 'Comedy', 'Crime', 'Drama', 'Family', 'Fantasy', 'Film-Noir', 'History', 'Horror', 'Music', 'Musical', 'Mystery', 'Romance', 'Sci-Fi', 'Sport', 'Thriller', 'War', 'Western', 'Documentary' } for tok in lst)) no_dupes = genre_lists.apply(lambda lst: len(lst) == len(set(lst))) assert lengths_ok.all() and tokens_allowed.all() and no_dupes.all() # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START has_key_genre = genre_lists.apply(lambda lst: any(tok in {'Drama', 'Comedy', 'Action'} for tok in lst)) assert has_key_genre.mean() >= 0.60 # ASSERTION_END # Validate poster links before embedding in HTML posters = df['Poster_Link'].astype(str) # ASSERTION_START starts_ok = posters.str.startswith('http://') | posters.str.startswith('https://') ends_ok = posters.str.lower().str.endswith('.jpg') | posters.str.lower().str.endswith('.jpeg') assert starts_ok.all() and ends_ok.all() # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START uniq_ratio = posters.nunique() / len(posters) assert uniq_ratio >= 0.95 # ASSERTION_END # Validate overview before injecting into HTML overview = df['Overview'].astype(str) # ASSERTION_START non_empty = overview.str.strip().ne('') assert non_empty.all() # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START lengths_ok = overview.str.len().between(50, 500, inclusive='both') no_angle = ~overview.str.contains(r'[<>]') assert lengths_ok.all() and no_angle.all() # ASSERTION_END # Validate certificate set before using as a badge cert = df['Certificate'] # ASSERTION_START non_null_ratio = cert.notna().mean() assert non_null_ratio >= 0.85 # ASSERTION_END present_mask = cert.notna() present_vals = cert[present_mask].astype(str) # ASSERTION_START allowed_certs = {'U', 'UA', 'A', 'G', 'PG', 'PG-13', 'R', 'NC-17', 'Not Rated', '12', '12A', '15', '18'} in_set = present_vals.isin(list(allowed_certs)) no_ws = present_vals == present_vals.str.strip() assert in_set.all() and no_ws.all() # ASSERTION_END # Validate votes before computing weights votes = pd.to_numeric(df['No_of_Votes'], errors='coerce') # ASSERTION_START assert votes.notna().all() and (votes > 0).all() # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START assert (votes >= 10000).mean() >= 0.95 # ASSERTION_END # Validate IMDB rating and meta-score relation before ranking rating = pd.to_numeric(df['IMDB_Rating'], errors='coerce') # ASSERTION_START within_bounds = (rating >= 0.0) & (rating <= 10.0) one_decimal = (np.abs(rating * 10 - np.round(rating * 10)) <= 1e-8) enough_high = (rating >= 7.0).mean() >= 0.90 assert rating.notna().all() and within_bounds.all() and one_decimal.all() and enough_high # ASSERTION_END meta = pd.to_numeric(df['Meta_score'], errors='coerce') both_mask = meta.notna() & rating.notna() if both_mask.sum() > 1: # ASSERTION_START corr_val = rating[both_mask].corr(meta[both_mask]) close_mask = (meta[both_mask] - rating[both_mask] * 10).abs() <= 30 assert (corr_val > 0.4) and (close_mask.mean() >= 0.80) # ASSERTION_END # Validate and parse gross for badges and summaries gross_series = df['Gross'] # ASSERTION_START assert gross_series.notna().mean() >= 0.80 # ASSERTION_END gross_non_null = gross_series.dropna().astype(str) gross_digits = gross_non_null.str.replace(',', '', regex=False) # ASSERTION_START parseable = gross_digits.str.match(r'^[0-9]+$') if parseable.any(): pass assert parseable.all() # ASSERTION_END gross_num = pd.Series(index=df.index, dtype='float64') gross_num.loc[gross_series.notna()] = pd.to_numeric(gross_digits, errors='coerce').values # ASSERTION_START gt_million_ratio = (gross_num[gross_series.notna()] > 1_000_000).mean() assert gt_million_ratio >= 0.50 # ASSERTION_END # Year-conditional gross completeness # ASSERTION_START yr_mask = df['Released_Year'] >= 1980 if yr_mask.any(): assert gross_series[yr_mask].notna().mean() >= 0.80 # ASSERTION_END # Validate cast assumptions before rendering cast lists # ASSERTION_START director_diff = ( (df['Director'] != df['Star1']) & (df['Director'] != df['Star2']) & (df['Director'] != df['Star3']) & (df['Director'] != df['Star4']) ) stars_all_distinct = ( (df['Star1'] != df['Star2']) & (df['Star1'] != df['Star3']) & (df['Star1'] != df['Star4']) & (df['Star2'] != df['Star3']) & (df['Star2'] != df['Star4']) & (df['Star3'] != df['Star4']) ) assert director_diff.all() and stars_all_distinct.all() # ASSERTION_END # Compute ranking score base_score = rating.copy() meta_scaled = meta / 10.0 base_score[both_mask] = 0.6 * rating[both_mask] + 0.4 * meta_scaled[both_mask] vote_weight = np.clip(np.log10(votes), 0, 6) / 6.0 final_score = base_score * (0.6 + 0.4 * vote_weight) # Expand rows by individual genre tokens for per-genre ranking rows = [] for idx, lst in genre_lists.items(): for g in lst: rows.append({ 'GenreToken': g, 'Series_Title': df.at[idx, 'Series_Title'], 'Released_Year': int(df.at[idx, 'Released_Year']), 'Poster_Link': df.at[idx, 'Poster_Link'], 'Overview': df.at[idx, 'Overview'], 'runtime_minutes': int(df.at[idx, 'runtime_minutes']), 'IMDB_Rating': float(rating.at[idx]), 'Meta_score': meta.at[idx] if pd.notna(meta.at[idx]) else np.nan, 'No_of_Votes': int(votes.at[idx]), 'Certificate': df.at[idx, 'Certificate'] if pd.notna(df.at[idx, 'Certificate']) else None, 'Gross_num': float(gross_num.at[idx]) if pd.notna(gross_num.at[idx]) else np.nan, 'Director': df.at[idx, 'Director'], 'Star1': df.at[idx, 'Star1'], 'Star2': df.at[idx, 'Star2'], 'Star3': df.at[idx, 'Star3'], 'Star4': df.at[idx, 'Star4'], 'final_score': float(final_score.at[idx]) }) genre_df = pd.DataFrame(rows) # Generate pages per genre present_genres = sorted([g for g in genre_df['GenreToken'].unique() if g in allowed_genres]) def fmt_int(n): try: return f"{int(n):,}" except Exception: return "" for g in present_genres: sub = genre_df[genre_df['GenreToken'] == g].sort_values('final_score', ascending=False) top_n = sub.head(12) blocks = [] for _, r in top_n.iterrows(): title = r['Series_Title'] year = r['Released_Year'] cert_val = r['Certificate'] if r['Certificate'] is not None else '' poster = r['Poster_Link'] synopsis = r['Overview'] runtime_m = int(r['runtime_minutes']) score_txt = f"{r['IMDB_Rating']:.1f}" metas = (f"{int(r['Meta_score'])}" if not pd.isna(r['Meta_score']) else '–') votes_txt = fmt_int(r['No_of_Votes']) gross_txt = fmt_int(r['Gross_num']) if not pd.isna(r['Gross_num']) else '–' cast = ", ".join([r['Star1'], r['Star2'], r['Star3'], r['Star4']]) director = r['Director'] ident = slugify(f"{title}-{year}") block = f"""

{title} ({year})

{cert_val} · {runtime_m} min · ⭐ {score_txt} · Metascore {metas} · {votes_txt} votes · Gross {gross_txt}

{synopsis}

Directed by {director}. Cast: {cast}.

""" blocks.append(block) html = f""" Top Rated {g} Films

Top Rated {g} Films

Back to index
{''.join(blocks)}
""" (out_dir / f"genre_{slugify(g)}.html").write_text(html, encoding='utf-8') # Build index page with quick links and summary tiles index_tiles = [] for g in present_genres: sub = genre_df[genre_df['GenreToken'] == g] avg_rating = sub['IMDB_Rating'].mean() count_titles = len(sub) link = f"genre_{slugify(g)}.html" tile = f"""

{g}

{count_titles} titles · Avg ⭐ {avg_rating:.2f}

 """ index_tiles.append(tile) index_html = f""" Weekly Editorial · Top Films by Genre

Weekly Editorial · Top Films by Genre

{''.join(index_tiles)}
Generated from curated catalog.
""" (out_dir / 'index.html').write_text(index_html, encoding='utf-8') if __name__ == '__main__': main()
